checklist.name: Bank accounts
checklist.ask: Do you have money in a bank, savings or offset account?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, across all of them?
checklist.hint: Count an offset account here; the home loan comes later.

checklist.name: Super
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, all funds together?
checklist.hint: Your fund’s app shows the balance; myGov lists every fund you have.

checklist.name: Investments
checklist.ask: Any investments outside super — shares, ETFs, an investing app?
checklist.amount: Roughly what are they worth today?

checklist.name: Home
checklist.ask: Do you own the home you live in?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Home loan
checklist.ask: Is there a home loan on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?
checklist.hint: Your latest statement shows what’s outstanding, before any offset.

checklist.name: Investment property

checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Investment loan
checklist.ask: Is there a loan on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?

checklist.name: Car
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Car loan

checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?
